# @d 实现链表反转函数

# @d 需要考虑空链表和单节点的情况

Define function reverse_list
input: head node
output: reversed head node
if head is null or head.next is null
  return head

# 三指针法反转
set prev = null
set curr = head
while curr is not null
  save next = curr.next
  curr.next = prev
  prev = curr
  curr = next

return prev

# 🎯 示例 2: 数据处理 — 数组去重
# ============================================================

# @d 实现数组去重函数
# @d 输入: 整数数组，输出: 去重后的新数组
# @d 要求保持原顺序，使用双指针法

Define function remove_duplicates
input: sorted array arr
output: new length

if arr is empty
  return 0

set write_pos = 1
for read_pos from 1 to len(arr)-1
  if arr[read_pos] != arr[read_pos - 1]
    arr[write_pos] = arr[read_pos]
    write_pos = write_pos + 1

return write_pos

# ============================================================

# @d 实现回文判断函数
# @d 输入: 字符串 s，输出: bool
# @d 忽略大小写和空格

Define function is_palindrome
input: string s
output: true if palindrome

set left = 0
set right = len(s) - 1

while left < right
  # 跳过非字母数字字符
  if s[left] is not alphanumeric
    left = left + 1
    continue
  if s[right] is not alphanumeric
    right = right - 1
    continue
  # 比较字符（忽略大小写）
  if lower(s[left]) != lower(s[right])
    return false
  left = left + 1
  right = right - 1

return true

# @d 实现链表反转函数
# @d 要求: 输入链表头节点，返回反转后的新头节点
# @d 需要考虑空链表和单节点的情况

Define function reverse_list
input: head node
output: reversed head node
if head is null or head.next is null
  return head

# 三指针法反转
set prev = null
set curr = head
while curr is not null
  save next = curr.next
  curr.next = prev
  prev = curr
  curr = next

return prev

Define function remove_duplicates
input: sorted array arr
output: new length

if arr is empty
  return 0

set write_pos = 1
for read_pos from 1 to len(arr)-1
  if arr[read_pos] != arr[read_pos - 1]
    arr[write_pos] = arr[read_pos]
    write_pos = write_pos + 1

return write_pos

# @d 实现回文判断函数

# @d 忽略大小写和空格

Define function is_palindrome
input: string s
output: true if palindrome

set left = 0
set right = len(s) - 1

while left < right
  # 跳过非字母数字字符
  if s[left] is not alphanumeric
    left = left + 1
    continue
  if s[right] is not alphanumeric
    right = right - 1
    continue
  # 比较字符（忽略大小写）
  if lower(s[left]) != lower(s[right])
    return false
  left = left + 1
  right = right - 1

return true
